buf.protoschema.custom.v1.CustomOptions..description:
`title`, `description`, and `default` directly override the schema's
 standard keywords. `properties` is a google.protobuf.Struct whose keys are
 written directly into the schema. The message is open to extension, so
 external types can embed arbitrary custom keywords via
 `extend buf.protoschema.custom.v1.CustomOptions`.

title.description: title overrides the generated schema's `title` keyword.

description.description: description overrides the generated schema's `description` keyword.

default.description:
default overrides the generated schema's `default` keyword. It is a
 google.protobuf.Value, so any JSON value can be expressed (number, string,
 bool, null, object, or array).

properties.description: properties is the set of custom keywords to inject into the schema.

buf.protoschema.custom.v1.CustomOptions..title: CustomOptions allows customizing the generated JSON Schema.
